title: ApplicationService
description: TOGAF-sourced structural archetype — application capability exposed to consumers, distinct from the implementing component. An active system: the service has Mechanisms (application functions it exposes), Effectors (API endpoints, responses), and Receptors (requests, events consumed). Extends Structure with TOGAF Application Architecture vocabulary. TOGAF mapping: Application Service (Content Metamodel, Application Architecture domain). Source framework: TOGAF (Application Architecture, Content Framework).

serviceType.description: Application service behavioral classification. INFORMATIONAL = read-only data retrieval. TRANSACTIONAL = state-changing operations. ANALYTICAL = computation and reporting. TOGAF mapping: Application Service type.

exposureLevel.description: Service exposure scope. PUBLIC = externally accessible. PARTNER = B2B/federation. INTERNAL = organization-only. TOGAF mapping: Application Service boundary.

version.description: Service version identifier (e.g., 'v2.1.0'). Enables version-aware governance and migration planning. TOGAF mapping: Application Service version.

lifecycle.description: Service lifecycle stage. Drives migration planning and dependency governance. TOGAF mapping: Application Service lifecycle status.
